en.title: Symbol Card Examples: Six Designs to Copy
en.description: Six symbol card examples built from copy-and-paste text symbols: stars, hearts, arrows, check marks, math signs and flowers, each linked to its full set.
en.lede: Six simple cards that show how text symbols look when you group them by theme.
en.intro: A symbol card puts a few related characters side by side so you can see which ones fit together before you copy them. Each card below is a small illustration of one set from the symbols collection: the stars, hearts, arrows, check marks, math signs and flowers that people ask for most. Use them as a starting point for a poster, a note or a checklist. Every card links to the full set, where each symbol can be copied with one tap and comes with notes on where it works.

entries.alt: Three stars: outlined, solid and four-pointed
entries.title: Star set
entries.caption: An outlined star, a solid star and a four-pointed sparkle in warm yellow, the combination people reach for when they rate something or mark a favourite item in plain text.

entries.alt: Three heart shapes: outlined, solid and double
entries.title: Heart set
entries.caption: An outlined heart, a solid heart and a double heart in pink and red. Hearts are the most copied decoration for bios, captions and messages, and a group shows the range of tone available.

entries.alt: Arrows pointing right, up, in both directions and diagonally
entries.title: Arrow set
entries.caption: Arrows that point right, up, both ways and diagonally, shown in blue on a pale background. They suit steps in a process, menus and short directions where a drawn diagram would be too heavy.

entries.alt: Three checkboxes: a ticked box, a crossed box and an empty box
entries.title: Check mark set
entries.caption: A ticked box, a crossed box and an empty box in green, red and grey. This trio covers the whole life of a to-do item, from open to done to rejected, in a plain text list.

entries.alt: Four math signs: plus, minus, multiplication and division
entries.title: Math set
entries.caption: The four basic operators drawn in purple: plus, minus, multiplication and division. Keyboards hide the last two, which is why students and writers copy them into reports and problem sets.

entries.alt: Three flowers with round petals and a snowflake
entries.title: Flower set
entries.caption: Two round-petalled flowers with yellow centres beside a blue snowflake. Floral characters decorate headings and dividers, and the group shows how a seasonal mix can sit in the same line.

faq: Are these cards the real symbols?
No. They are small illustrations of each set. The real symbols are plain text characters on the linked pages, where you can copy them.
They are drawings made for this demo site. Replace them with your own images when you build a site from the template.

zh.title: 符号卡片示例：六种可以直接复制的设计
zh.description: 用可复制粘贴的文字符号做成的六张符号卡片：星星、爱心、箭头、对勾、数学符号和花朵，每一张都链接到完整的符号合集。
zh.lede: 六张简单的卡片，展示文字符号按主题放在一起是什么样子。
zh.intro: 符号卡片把几个相关的字符并排放在一起，让你在复制之前先看看哪些搭配起来合适。下面每一张卡片都是符号合集中某一组的小插图：人们最常找的星星、爱心、箭头、对勾、数学符号和花朵。你可以把它们当作海报、笔记或清单的起点。每张卡片都链接到完整的合集，在那里可以一键复制每个符号，还附有它适用场合的说明。这些卡片只是示意，方便你在动手之前先比较一下不同主题的风格，再决定要用哪一组。

entries.alt: 三颗星星：空心、实心和四角星
entries.title: 星星组
entries.caption: 一颗空心星、一颗实心星和一颗四角星，用暖黄色表示。给事物打分、或在纯文本里标出最喜欢的条目时，人们常用的就是这一组。

entries.alt: 三个爱心：空心、实心和双心
entries.title: 爱心组
entries.caption: 一颗空心爱心、一颗实心爱心和一对双心，用粉色和红色表示。爱心是个人简介、配文和消息里最常被复制的装饰，一组放在一起能看出语气上的不同选择。

entries.alt: 箭头分别指向右、上、双向和斜向
entries.title: 箭头组
entries.caption: 指向右、上、双向和斜向的箭头，在浅色背景上用蓝色表示。它们适合表示流程里的步骤、菜单和简短的指引，用画图来表示的话会显得太重。

entries.alt: 三个方框：打了对勾、打了叉和空白
entries.title: 对勾组
entries.caption: 一个打了对勾的方框、一个打了叉的方框和一个空方框，分别用绿色、红色和灰色表示。这三个符号覆盖了待办事项从未完成到完成再到被否决的全过程，在纯文本清单里就能用。

entries.alt: 四个数学符号：加号、减号、乘号和除号
entries.title: 数学组
entries.caption: 用紫色画出的四个基本运算符号：加、减、乘、除。键盘上找不到后两个，所以学生和写作者常把它们复制到报告和习题里。

entries.alt: 两朵圆形花瓣的花和一片雪花
entries.title: 花朵组
entries.caption: 两朵黄色花心的圆瓣花，旁边是一片蓝色的雪花。花朵字符常用来装饰标题和分隔线，这一组展示了季节性的搭配怎样放进同一行里。

faq: 这些卡片上的就是真正的符号吗？
不是。它们只是每一组符号的小插图。真正的符号是链接页面上的纯文本字符，可以在那里复制。
它们是为这个演示站点画的插图。用模板建站时，请换成你自己的图片。
